- (f) (i) Contribution to the account under a Pension Scheme notified by the Central Government as does not exceed-
- (a) in the case of an employee, 10% of his salary;
- 14%, where such contribution is made by the Central/
- (b) State Government;
- (c) in any other case, 20% of gross total income.
